instruction: Use Allegro's batch report utility on `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\fulladd_placed_routed.brd` to export the routed-board etch-length reports, and write them to `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\eln.txt` and `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\eld.txt`.
